text:
[Council File 26-1542; CD 8]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (HARRIS-DAWSON - HERNANDEZ) relative to preparing and executing a Supplemental Agreement to Contract No. C-134516 for the continued design and construction of the Destination Crenshaw Project.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. AUTHORIZE the Bureau of Engineering (BOE), in coordination with the City Attorney, to prepare and execute a Supplemental Agreement to Contract No. C-134516 between the City of Los Angeles, acting through the Bureau of Engineering, and the Destination Crenshaw nonprofit that extends the term to March 31, 2028 for the continued design and construction of the Destination Crenshaw Project.
2. AUTHORIZE the BOE to make any technical corrections or clarifications to the above instructions to effectuate the intent of this Motion.
